context: Simplifying the payment processing error handling to reduce nesting.
explanation: The bare except: pass silences every exception (network errors, invalid data, gateway timeouts) and then unconditionally marks the payment as "paid" — even when the charge actually failed or never reached the gateway. A declined card now creates a "paid" Payment and confirms the order. Fix: keep the specific except clause, record the correct status, and re-raise or return an error.
